MissionSettings.Blurb: One of Major Kelly's dropships was moving over the Hung archipelago-supposedly 'safe' airspace-when it was hit by fire from orbital guns. The crew managed to land safely, but their transmissions were cut off soon after.We fear that the Dropship inadvertently found a new Liao installation and paid the price. Your task is to go in, secure the Dropship, rescue the crew, disable the orbital guns, and then extract.We'll be dropping you several kilometers to the southwest; we can't risk losing another Dropship to those orbital guns. After that, it's all up to you, Commander.
